policies.title: Seychellois passports: named advance visitor-visa cohort
policies.summary: Seychelles' July 2025 passport-holder schedule expressly requires these destinations to issue a visa before entry, rather than treating an online form or airport process as the visitor baseline.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary Seychellois passport short-visitor baseline in the Ministry's current named list.
The schedule's wording requires a visa before entry but does not establish an electronic or border-issued route, so this is normalized only as advance visa required.
Mission availability, individual grant, document, route, transit, work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-passport treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Seychellois passports: named visa-free short-visit cohort
policies.summary: Seychelles' live Foreign Ministry waiver table expressly identifies these destinations as not requiring a visa for Seychellois passport holders and supplies the listed stay limits.
conditions: The source lists Bangladesh for one to three months; Cambodia for two weeks; North Macedonia for 90 to 180 days; and Cabo Verde for 60 days.
It lists Comoros, Sierra Leone, Tunisia and Solomon Islands for one to three months; Côte d'Ivoire and Djibouti for 30 days; and Grenada for 90 days.

The table is a live passport-government schedule but has no visible table update date; confirm directly before travel. Work, residence, transit, special passports and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Seychellois ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Seychelles in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: The Embassy page states a maximum stay of three months for the named no-visa-required cohort.
This covers ordinary Seychellois passports and short visitor travel only; passport validity, onward travel, funds, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Seychellois ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board table expressly makes a visitor visa available to Seychellois nationals on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: The listed visa is obtained on arrival and costs 40 JOD.
Jordan's table says all non-Jordanians must register on Gateway2Jordan before departure for a QR code.
Work, residence, special travel documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
